notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.notes:
Now the game has a checkpoint system!

A new audio was attached to the blue clown event and some adjustments were made to the scenario.

* Observation *
Upon leaving the game your progress in the game will be lost.

notes.title: TEST UPDATE
notes.notes:
OBS *
Many are complaining about the game not having a checkpoint system, I am reviewing this part and soon I will bring you news on this subject.

See you soon!!

notes.title: Update Ver1.1
notes.notes:
Some players asked me for the character Suzi to start with a loaded gun. In response to this request, I made some changes.

* Now Suzi starts with a loaded gun.

* Use the correct weapon to kill the dolls.

* Fixed some bugs.


** Important detail **
The weapon only kills certain enemies, other enemies you need to use other items in the game for criminals.
